content.en: The **Money Supply** refers to the total stock of money circulating in an economy at a specific point in time. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) classifies this into different measures based on **liquidity**, which is the ease with which an asset can be converted into cash.

definition.en: Narrow money is highly liquid, while broad money includes less liquid assets like fixed deposits.
